europe_now.title: Estonia closes Russian border following sabotage attempt
europe_now.summary: Estonia is shutting down its border crossings with Russia after a sabotage attempt occurred at a domestic drone manufacturing facility. Authorities directly accused Russia of orchestrating the attempted arson attack on the defense firm.

sources.headline: Estonia to close Russian border crossings after 'sabotage' attempt at drone factory
Estonia accuses Russia of attempted arson attack on defense firm

europe_now.title: Romania condemns Black Sea drone strikes
europe_now.summary: The Romanian government has strongly criticized recent drone strikes targeting shipping vessels in the Black Sea. Officials condemned the attacks as entirely unacceptable security violations within the region.

sources.headline: Romania slams ‘unacceptable’ drone strikes on Black Sea ships
